description: Reviewed two-layer routing: ordered J2.33-40 GDT commands, back-layer CST zero-crossing pair alongside the GDT2 command bundle, straight ADC bus trunks, 0603 ADC passives, relocated rails, local unbuffered power/bridge-leg indicators; obsolete enable and FPGA LED logic removed. FRSTDATA now terminates at local TP1; J7.7 is unused. AUX channel order is AUX1/AUX2/AUX3/AUX4, matching the connector-aligned rows without inter-channel route crossovers. AUX unity-buffer feedback is local on F.Cu; five unnecessary feedback vias removed. CST CH5-8 fully connected; direct regulator-to-CST 3V3 feed; via-free indicator above U2; four U53 input resistors below its package. Front-layer 3V3 feeds, horizontal indicator left of U2, removed abandoned ground copper, four parallel low-side gate resistor pairs. Removed both ADC-to-C5 3V3 transition vias; connection now entirely F.Cu. Four 0.6 mm front-layer HO paths under SOICs; uniform 2.5 x 3.4 mm input-resistor groups below U51-U54. CST local 3V3 branches on F.Cu with six redundant supply vias removed. R416 aligned above C413 at x=109 mm with local lead adjustments. Shared negative-rail generator centered between AUX and CST conditioning, local loop preserved and supply leads shortened. C741 relocated next to U73/C733 negative supply bypass; obsolete branch and one via removed. C429 CT1_RAW filter relocated beside R401/D40, clear of the rear +5V_ADC trunks; local front-layer leads and one fewer ground via. U42 passive alignment: R414 on the D43/C410 axis, C412 oriented for direct CT1_MID routing, and C424 in the R416/C413 column at 3.45 mm pitch; seven surplus segments removed, no added vias. D62 moved above D61 at 3 mm pitch; feedback rerouted on F.Cu, two vias removed and the CT2 rectifier copper shortened by 4.2349 mm. CT1_ZERO and CT2_ZERO use 0.20 mm back-layer trunks at x=119.8/120.6 mm, 0.80 mm pitch alongside GDT2; both return to F.Cu at the FPGA via group. The bias-rail crossing via is at (118,119) mm. VBAT_24V upper bridge feed is 2.50 mm F.Cu through D50.1, removing both three-via transition banks; EXT_CLOCK crosses it on B.Cu from J7.8 and returns at (134.5,42) mm (net five vias removed). AUX2_0_5V input under R711 is one continuous 0.25 mm F.Cu trace from (31.5,89.5) to (57.5,89.5) mm, eliminating the two-via back-layer hop. U44 negative charge-pump block (U44/R421/C420-C423) translated 13.6 mm right with its flying-capacitor loop. Negative output spur shortened 13.6 mm; +5V_ADC bridge passes down its left side and feeds the relocated input via, with no added vias. C333 rotated 90 degrees with its VBAT pad at (77.05,37) mm; the adjacent 24 V detour is replaced by the straight 2.5 mm F.Cu bus, shortening copper 4.95 mm without adding vias. ADC +5 V branches at C4/C2 and the C1 feed through the LQFP pad ring moved to F.Cu; three local vias removed. Incoming B.Cu feed at R20/C10 and all other rail distribution retained. Finished both LMZ14202H converter RON, UVLO, soft-start and feedback networks with 0.25 mm traces and six 0.6/0.3 mm vias; original copper and component positions retained. Finished ADC reference/regulator capacitors C6-C9: five open connections closed, with explicit ground returns. Short layer bridges cross existing supply copper and preserve ground thermal access. Original copper and placement retained. Simplified the annotated CT2_HALF branch to TP61 entirely on front copper: two vias removed, R606 tap straightened, 6.29 mm shorter, connectivity and placement retained. Moved CST1 diode D42 from (65,137) to (65,124.5), above D41, retaining 180-degree polarity. Matched the compact front-copper topology of D62, with clearance for C420. Replaced CT1_RECT_DRIVE and CT1_HALF copper, removing four vias; local silkscreen borders adjusted. J7 service/monitor/clock header removed with all 10 EXT_CLOCK tracks and three vias. J1.11/12/15/16 and J2.32 are unused on this controller; shared ground and other copper retained. U44 shared negative-rail block moved 4 mm right and 5 mm up to clear CST1 diodes; local charge-pump loops translated intact, two supply branches adjusted without extra vias. Connector-aligned AUX rows with raw, buffered, and ground probe pads. R20/C10/C9/C7 aligned at 2.5 mm pitch on y=82.5 mm; local power feed and ground return updated. AUX1-AUX4 remapped to ADC CH1-CH4 at R1-R4. All buffered AUX paths stay on F.Cu; both output crossovers and four vias removed, with CST CH5-CH8 unchanged. CST channels condensed to a matched 17 mm pitch with shortened lower probe/bypass area; electrical contract unchanged. U30/U31 feedback taps simplified with R300/R310 and C301/C311 rotated 180 degrees in place, matching direct divider branches and no added vias. J5 is the HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 USB-C receptacle for self-powered programming. U3 protects both data lines; R24/R25 terminate CC1/CC2 separately. USB_VBUS only feeds protection and the R26/R27 sense divider to J1.20 (GPIO8). Host VBUS is isolated from VIN_5V.; paired ADC ±5 V distribution along the right side of the conditioning rows; annotated U44 negative-output bottom bridge now on F.Cu with two vias removed; nearby positive-rail transition moved below the crossing Series battery input review: J4 upper 12 V, J30 lower 12 V; isolated BAT_MID_12V straight 2.5 mm front link J4.2 to J30.1. Single 24 V uses J4.1 and J30.2. Re-fed U30 UVLO from VBAT_24V bus; all other copper preserved.; straighten +12 V at y=74.7 mm and cross J2 on back; simplify ADC fanout to front with transitions near ADC; straighten D70-D73 +5V_ADC back-layer clamp supply through the aligned vias at x=45.2 mm; align the four lower GDT2 bend starts with CT1_ZERO at y=124.1 mm, preserving all vias and 0.2 mm B.Cu widths; extend the J2 right via column to ten vias at 0.9 mm pitch and straighten CT1/CT2 ZERO front-layer crossover links, preserving widths and via sizes; replace the auxiliary supply detour beside C702 and R740 with a direct front-layer link, removing one redundant via and preserving the supply trunk and component placement
